table.legend: <meets>Green</meets> meets Regional Rail: all {{hours}} hours with a train every 30 minutes, no wait over 30 minutes, 90%+ of trains on a clock-face pattern. <partway>Amber</partway> is partway: at least half the hours, hourly waits, or half the trains. <far>Red</far> is further off.

notes.vision: Built from the MBTA's published schedules, not trains actually run. TransitMatters' Regional Rail vision calls for a train at least every 30 minutes in both directions, from 5am to 1am, on a repeating hourly pattern riders can memorize. <reports>Read our Regional Rail reports</reports>.
notes.method: Each direction is measured at its Boston terminal: outbound trains when they leave, inbound trains when they arrive. A wait spans the trains on either side of the window, so a 7am train followed by a 4pm train counts as a 9-hour midday wait. Clock-face trains have another train exactly an hour before or after, within two minutes. Holidays are counted with the kind of day they fall on.
